title: Material import workflow: raw table hash and provenance, passive fit over a declared band, ADE n/k discretization error, extrapolation warning, project persistence

fixture.public_table: tests/fixtures/materials/sio2_sellmeier_malitson1965.csv: 81 wavelengths from 0.4 to 2.0 um of n from the Sellmeier equation of Malitson, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 55, 1205 (1965) stated in the file header, k = 0
fixture.synthetic_table: authored two-pole Lorentz permittivity (epsilon_inf 2.3; poles (1.7e15 rad/s, 4e30 rad^2/s^2, 2e14 rad/s) and (3e15, 2e30, 5e14)) at 61 wavelengths from 0.8 to 2.0 um, written as wavelength_nm or wavelength_um, epsilon_real, epsilon_imag text
fixture.fit_options: max_poles 3, tolerance 1e-4 (SiO2); max_poles 2 or 3, tolerance 1e-6 or 1e-4, include_drude False (Lorentz); ADE-target fit at dt 4e-17 s on 0.9 to 1.9 um for the persistence test
fixture.discretization: dt 5e-17 s and 2.5e-17 s over 0.4 to 2.0 um, 201 samples
fixture.workbench: tests/ui/material-provenance.spec.js: import the SiO2 table with source and licence, fit, use, read the provenance and band panel, move the source to 2.5 um, save the project

reference_method: the Sellmeier formula itself at held-out wavelengths; hashlib.sha256 of the raw bytes; an independent evaluation of the fitted poles with omega -> (2/dt) tan(omega dt/2) for the discretization error; the second-order scaling of that error with dt

observables.name: raw_sha256
observables.definition: MaterialProvenance.raw_sha256 against hashlib.sha256 of the file bytes or the submitted text

observables.name: held_out_n_error
observables.definition: max |Re sqrt(eps_fit) - n_Sellmeier| at 97 wavelengths not in the table

observables.name: discretization_n_error
observables.definition: discretization_report max_abs_n_error at dt and at dt/2, and their ratio

observables.name: extrapolation_warning
observables.definition: MaterialBandWarning message and its presence in estimate(project)['warnings'] and /api/validate

observables.name: persisted_fields
observables.definition: provenance, fit_band_um, fit_dt_s, samples and poles after Project.save/load

acceptance.provenance: raw_sha256 equals the SHA-256 of the raw bytes; source, licence, file name, columns, unit and date are kept on the Material and in the project JSON
acceptance.fit: SiO2 converges within 3 poles at tolerance 1e-4; held-out n error below 2e-4 and |k| below 1e-6; the Lorentz table converges within 2 poles at 1e-6 with permittivity error below 1e-5
acceptance.discretization: max_abs_n_error equals the independent bilinear evaluation to 1e-12 relative; error ratio dt over dt/2 between 3.8 and 4.2; k error below 1e-8 for the lossless table
acceptance.extrapolation: a band inside the fitted band gives no warning; a band outside raises MaterialBandWarning naming both bands and the material, and the same text is in the estimate and validation warnings
acceptance.failure_is_explicit: an unconverged fit is returned with converged False and require_tolerance raises
acceptance.source_of_limits: G6-01 specification; the fit tolerance and error limits are fixture-specific budgets declared here before the run

not_yet_covered: a measured (non-formula) public table with noise and its licence text
the spectral tails of a pulse beyond the declared source range (the band check uses the declared range, as the estimate does)
FSP writeback of the provenance (native FSP export of fitted materials remains unsupported)

notes: Declared at 73203d2 before the run; the workflow, the fixture table and the tests land in the same commit as this case.
